summary: Move generic105/20 mparpsile from Preterit to Infectum.
rationale: Parallel mḥalqile and generic saymi clauses plus -i subject/-le patient favour Infectum. Preserve the inherited German omission of the scattering verb; do not invent its translation.

summary: Move the generic gold-scattering example to Infectum
rationale: In 105/20, mparpsile occurs with mḥalqile, saymi and lo saymi in a generic hypothetical sequence, rendered "man mag es ... werfen; was man auch mit ihm anstellt". The target is mparps-i-le, plural Infectum with an object suffix, not the Preterit mparpasle given in the stem forms. The example is currently filed in the transitive Preterit box.

summary: New sense 2: zerfetzen, in Stücke zerstören
rationale: Two book-destruction contexts with rifle fire entail physical damage, distinct from disordering papers. Existing Detransitive ship-shattering independently supports the destructive result.

data.turoyo: <...> Hayo stene midalle, simalle hadaf la tfəngaṯṯe, hayo ste ba tfənag mparpəsalle laḥ ḥanfe.
data.translation: <...> Auch diese Fangito nahmen sie (d.h. die Muslime) und stellten sie zur Zielscheibe für ihre Gewehr(schüsse). Die je Ungläubigen zerstörten auch diese mit den Gewehren.

rationale: New destructive sense; feminine patient index, explicit l-marked agents and rifle instrument. Clearer person marking than2/7.

summary: The book passages share one destructive result, not two new senses. Talay2/19 explicitly marks agents laḥ ḥanfe and indexes a feminine patient;2/7 uses plural book patients in a partly syncretic form.

Existing97/37 mparpso is Detransitive Preterit: ship as affected subject, storm as causal context, pieces distributed afterward. Its implicit sense1 is distinct from active numbering and lacks a printed gloss list.
105/20 is generic gold scattering, not a completed past act in context. The inherited note correctly says the German lacks a separate rendering; the move preserves that edition translation.
Retain the glossary's I label for the four-consonant formation; no new stem is required.
Confirm Infectum reclassification of105/20 against the paradigm; the generic parallel clauses make it preferable to inherited Preterit.
Talay2/7 mparpsənne is partly syncretic between Preterit and Infectum in a preceding -wa sequence.2/19 supplies the clearer new-sense example; verify2/7 before using it to establish another box.
Supply an explicit Detransitive sense1 gloss such as zerschellen/in Stücke gehen for the existing ship event; retain its numbering.
Does destructive prps always entail fragmentation, or can it denote broader wrecking? Proposed gloss stays with the attested book/ship result.
